g.text: SLEEP IS A RUNWAY, NOT A SWITCH.
you don’t fall asleep at 11 — you begin landing at 7.
THE COOL / DARK / QUIET ROOM — touchdown into Part 2.0
THE SWITCH MODEL — full speed to 11 PM, then a cliff
fixed wake time + 10–20 min outdoor light
sets tonight’s landing — melatonin ≈ 14–16 h later
finish hard training · last big meal
the last 4 hours = the start of sleep
SABOTEURS — forces that push the approach back UP
ALCOHOL — sedation is not sleep · wrecks the 2nd half (4 AM)
THE PHONE — the one red go-around
for the lifter: a controlled descent = a bigger deep-sleep GH pulse = a better session tomorrow
first-line treatment for insomnia — beats pills.
a racing mind is behavioural, not chemical —
the fix is the runway, not a bottle.
fly the approach and you touch down clean · slam the switch and you spend the first hour still in the air.
PART 2 OF 5 · SLEEP · THE HEALTHY PILLAR
IF YOU’RE SO SMART, WHY ARE YOU NOT
